items: 1 cup dry brown or green lentils (or 2 1/2 cups cooked)
2 tbsp ground flaxseed and 5 tbsp water
Glaze: 1/3 cup ketchup, 1 tbsp maple syrup, 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
Simmer the lentils in 3 cups of water for 20 to 25 minutes, until tender. Drain.
Stir the flaxseed into the water and let it sit 10 minutes to thicken.
Heat the oven to 375°F and line a 9 by 5 inch loaf pan with parchment.
Cook the onion, carrots and celery in the oil for 6 to 8 minutes. Add the mushrooms and cook until their liquid is gone, about 8 minutes. Ad
Pulse half the lentils with the oats in a food processor until coarse. Mix with the vegetables, the rest of the lentils, the flax and the br
Press firmly into the pan. Stir the glaze together and spread it on top.
Bake 45 to 50 minutes, until firm. Rest 15 minutes before lifting it out and slicing.

items: 3 tbsp plant butter or olive oil

Add the mushrooms and cook until browned, 6 to 8 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the flour and cook 1 to 2 minutes.
Whisk in the broth a little at a time, then the soy sauce and thyme.

items: 3 lb Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cubed
3/4 to 1 cup unsweetened plain oat or soy milk, warmed
Cover the potatoes and garlic with cold salted water and bring to a boil.
Simmer 15 to 20 minutes, until a fork slides in easily. Drain.
Mash with the garlic, butter and warm milk, adding milk until it is as creamy as you like.
Season with salt and top with chives.

items: 1 lb day-old bread, cut in cubes (about 12 cups; check the label for milk, eggs or honey)
2 tbsp fresh sage, chopped (or 2 tsp dried)
If the bread is fresh, dry the cubes in a 300°F oven for 15 to 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 375°F and grease a 9 by 13 inch dish.
Melt the butter and cook the onion and celery 8 to 10 minutes. Add the herbs for 1 minute.
Toss with the bread. Pour in broth until moist but not soggy. Season.
Bake covered for 20 minutes, then uncovered 20 to 25 minutes, until golden.

h2: Crispy Potato Latkes with Cashew Sour Cream
items: 2 tbsp ground flaxseed and 6 tbsp water
1/3 cup all-purpose flour or matzo meal
1 tsp salt, plus more to finish
Cashew sour cream: 1 cup raw cashews, 1/2 cup water, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tsp apple cider vinegar, 1/2 tsp salt
For the sour cream, cover the cashews with boiling water for 15 minutes, drain, then blend with the water, lemon, vinegar and salt until smo
Stir the flaxseed into the water and let it sit 10 minutes to thicken.
Grate the potatoes and onion. Wrap them in a clean towel and squeeze out as much liquid as you can.
Mix the potatoes and onion with the flax, flour, salt, baking powder and pepper.
Heat a quarter inch of oil in a heavy pan over medium-high heat. Drop in a quarter cup of the mix and flatten it.
Fry 3 to 4 minutes a side, until deep golden. Drain on a rack, salt them, and keep them warm in a 200°F oven while you fry the rest.
Serve with the sour cream and applesauce.

items: 1/4 cup sugar (organic or beet sugar is never filtered with bone char)
1 tbsp ground flaxseed and 3 tbsp water
Stir the yeast and a pinch of the sugar into the warm milk and let it sit 5 minutes. Stir the flaxseed into the water.
Mix in the rest of the sugar, the flax and the butter, then the flour and salt. Knead 6 to 8 minutes, until smooth.
Cover and let it rise in a warm spot for about an hour, until doubled.
Roll it half an inch thick and cut 2 1/2 inch rounds. Let them rise 30 minutes.
Heat 2 inches of oil to 350°F. Fry a few at a time, 1 to 1 1/2 minutes a side, until golden. Drain.
Poke a hole in each side, pipe in the jam, and dust with powdered sugar.

items: 1/2 cup brown sugar (organic or beet sugar)
1 tbsp ground flaxseed and 3 tbsp water
Icing: 1 cup powdered sugar and 1 to 2 tbsp plant milk
Stir the flaxseed into the water and let it sit 10 minutes.
Whisk the flour, spices, baking soda and salt.
Beat the butter and sugar until fluffy, then the molasses, flax and vanilla. Mix in the dry ingredients.

Heat the oven to 350°F. Roll a quarter inch thick, cut your shapes and bake 8 to 10 minutes.
Cool, then decorate with the icing.
